ios.desc:
Audionotes: AI Voice Notes & Meeting Transcriptions

Audionotes is the AI notes app that elevates your voice memos to structured text. Record your meeting minutes, lecture notes, brainstorming sessions, or personal journaling—Audionotes handles the rest with instant transcription, summaries, and actionable insights. 


Whether you’re a student looking to transcribe class discussions, a busy professional needing speech to text meeting minutes, or someone seeking an ADHD-friendly note taker, Audionotes keeps your mind clear and your tasks organized.

WHY CHOOSE AUDIONOTES

Complete AI Note Taking, more than just voicenotes
- Unlimited AI Note-Taking
- Support for voice recordings, text notes, notes from images, and notes from file uploads
- Notes from youtube videos

Instant Transcripts & Summaries
- Convert audio to text in seconds and get concise summaries to speed up review.

Lecture Notes, Flashcards & Quizzes
- Get high quality lecture notes, flashcards and quizzes from your lectures, youtube videos or live lectures

Custom AI Outputs
- Automatically generate tasks, follow-up items, quiz questions, flashcards, outlines—whatever suits your workflow.

WhatsApp Integration
- Easily transcribe and summarize audio directly through our WhatsApp bot. Perfect for teams or quick voice memos on the go.

Cross-Platform Sync
- Access your notes from iOS, web, and our Chrome extension. Stay in sync across devices.

Privacy-First & Secure

WHO IS AUDIONOTES FOR?

Students & Educators
- Lecture Notes: Get crystal-clear text from classroom recordings.
- Study Guides: Turn transcripts into flashcards, quiz questions, or outlines.
- YouTube & Online Lectures: Paste links and watch Audionotes create content from them.
Professionals & Entrepreneurs

Meeting Minutes: Real-time transcription with speaker detection.
- Action Items & Tasks: Automatically extract to-do lists and follow-ups.
- Emails & Reports: Generate polished emails, client updates, and summaries from voice recordings.

Healthcare Professionals
- Medical Transcription: Dictate SOAP notes and patient summaries.
- Patient Interaction Logs: Quickly transcribe consults for accurate documentation.


Content Creators
- Blog Posts & Social Media: Convert voice thoughts into polished articles, LinkedIn posts, or tweet threads.
- Script Generation: Draft YouTube video scripts or podcast outlines from raw voice notes.

ADHD & Neurodiverse Users
- Brain Dump: Record thoughts without the overwhelm of typing.
- Focus & Or

quotes.text:
We launched the first version of Audionotes (www.audionotes.app) in May 2023, riding the Whisper/AI voice notes hype wave. Built it on Bubble, jumped on the hype train, but something wasn't clicking despite all our improvements.

The hard truth? We didn't really know what problem we were solving or who we were solving it for. Most importantly - we weren't even using our own product.

A few months ago - we went through some serious soul-searching. We talked to our users (like, really talked), figured out what actually mattered, understood who needed this, and decided to build something we'd genuinely love to use ourselves.

In 4 months of building, we've rebuilt Audionotes from the ground up. It's now a voice-first but complete note-taking app that just works. Perfect for brain dumps, meeting captures, lecture notes, or daily journaling.

What we've built:
- The whole package: voice notes, file uploads, text notes, scanned images, and YouTube video notes
- Transcription, summaries, and custom outputs that actually make sense
- Smart meeting notes with speaker detection
- Chat with your notes (single or all) - like having a conversation with your brain
- WhatsApp bot for instant transcription and summaries
Plays nice with others: Notion, Zapier, and webhook support
- Web, iOS, Android, and Chrome Extension

We've poured our hearts into this rebuild, and it feels different this time because we're building for ourselves as much as for our users.

Would love for you to try it out …
